caption:
Thursday fasting and the day deeds are presented.

The Prophet ﷺ said that deeds are presented on Monday and Thursday, and that he loved for his deeds to be presented while he was fasting. A quiet Sunnah worth bringing back into your week.

Jami at-Tirmidhi 747 · Grade: Sahih

Fasting today, or planning for Monday? Tell us below.

#hadith #sunnahfasting #thursdayfast #mondaythursday
